hook: *8* departments, incl. Cyberabad police, hunt NH-44 black spots
hook_b: *8* departments, incl. Cyberabad police, hunt NH-44 black spots
tldr: Cyberabad Police, NHAI, R&B and other departments launched a joint exercise to find accident-prone stretches and fix road defects.

beats.what: Officials inspected frequent-crash locations on NH-44 and are studying technical shortcomings.
beats.why: Frequent accidents on NH-44 and other major roads raised public safety concerns.
beats.care: If you drive NH-44 through Cyberabad, engineering fixes at risky stretches may follow.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: Additional Collector Faizan Ahmed and Traffic DCP-II S Seshadri Reddy did a field inspection of accident-prone NH-44 stretches with traffic, NHAI, R&B, transport, health, revenue and municipal officials.

cards.q: Do you feel safe on highway stretches around Hyderabad?

qs: Will the list of identified black spots be made public?

facts.t: Traffic police, law enforcement, NHAI, R&B, transport, health, revenue and municipal administration are *all* in the drive.

steps.e: Field inspection of crash-prone NH-44 stretches

viz.verdict: Fixes planned; no list of spots yet

learn.t: Black spot = a road stretch where crashes keep happening.

watch: Which stretches get corrective engineering first; no list or timeline given yet.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Cyberabad Police, agencies launch drive to identify accident black spots on NH-44

fact: Cyberabad police and NHAI are among *8* departments mapping NH-44 crash black spots.
twist: The drive also covers problem stretches on the Pudur route, not just NH-44.
